chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, peace be upon them both, said:
“The one who performs saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah is interceded for by the angels, and their intercession concerning him is accepted with affirmation.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا: Ṣafā, one of the two well-known stations of saʿy in hajj
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: Marwah, the second station of saʿy in hajj
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who intercede by Allah's permission
key_terms.تَشْفَعُ: intercedes or pleads on behalf of someone

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of performing saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the spiritual merit of performing saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah during hajj. It states that the angels intercede for the pilgrim who performs this rite, and that this intercession is accepted.
